answer_1.quote: We conduct an empirical study with 3 openweight LLMs for a total of 21 input rewriting methods... translation from English into German, Russian and Chinese... and we further evaluate the generalizability of our best performing approach on translation from English into Czech, Hebrew and Japanese.
answer_1.outputs: rewritten source sentences (simplified, paraphrased, stylistic) and their translations

answer_2.quote: We use XCOMET as our main evaluation metric, as it shows the best correlation with human judgments. We also report METRICX scores.

answer_4.quote: We use Qualtrics to design our survey and Prolific to recruit human annotators... Annotators evaluate which sentence is better across four dimensions: 1) Fluency, 2) Understandability, 3) Level of detail, and 4) Meaning preservation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare original MT and rewrite MT and judge fluency, understandability, level of detail, and meaning preservation.
